intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Convert to the same form (decimals best)
2  Line up decimal points, compare left to right
commonMistakes: Comparing fractions without converting — 3/8 vs 2/5 needs converting first.
Bigger denominator does NOT mean bigger fraction — 1/8 < 1/4.

questions.content: Convert to decimals and order largest to smallest: 7/10,  0.68,  72%,  3/4
Test scores — Ali: 17/20, Beth: 82%, Carl: 0.88, Dee: 4/5. Order highest to lowest.
Write a fraction, a decimal and a percentage that are all between 0.6 and 0.7 (all different values).
Offers: A = 1/3 off, B = 30% off, C = 0.35 off. a) Biggest discount? b) Smallest? c) Save on £60 with Offer A?
Sam: 'Bigger numerator = bigger fraction.' a) Give a counter-example. b) Correct method. c) Order: 5/12, 3/7, 2/5.
